metadata.description: Generate 3D models from a single image with Hi3D.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

enable_pbr.description: Generate PBR material maps together with the texture. Only supported (and billed) for v2.0/v2.1 and v3.0 models when enable_texture is true; ignored otherwise.
enable_pbr.title: Enable Pbr

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, input images are checked for safety before processing.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

enable_texture.description: Whether to generate textures in addition to geometry. When false, only the geometry mesh is generated (and billed).
enable_texture.title: Enable Texture

export_format.description: File format of the generated model.
export_format.title: Export Format

face_count.description: Target face count of the generated model. When unset, the partner picks the recommended count for the resolution (e.g. 500k for 512, 1M for 1024, 2M for 1536).
face_count.title: Face Count

image_url.description: URL of the input image. PNG, JPEG and WebP formats are supported, up to 20MB.
image_url.title: Image Url

model.description: Model version used for generation. 'hitem3d*' are the general models; 'scene-portrait*' are tuned for portraits/characters.
model.title: Model

resolution.description: Generation resolution. Supported values depend on the model: v1.5/v2.0 accept 512, 1024, 1536 and 1536pro; v2.1 accepts 1536fast and 1536pro; scene-portraitv1.5 accepts 1536; scene-portraitv2.0 accepts 1536pro; scene-portraitv2.1 accepts 1536profast and 1536pro. Defaults to the model's recommended resolution (1024 for v1.5/v2.0, the fast tier otherwise).
resolution.title: Resolution

Hitem3dImageTo3dOutput.description: Output of the 3D model generation endpoints.

thumbnail.description: Preview image of the generated model, when available.

Hitem3dImageTo3dOutput.title: Hitem3DOutput

info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/hitem3d/image-to-3d queue.
info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/hitem3d/image-to-3d

x-fal-metadata.about:
Generate a 3D model from a single image.

Uses the Sparc3D/Ultra3D-based HItem3D models. Set
enable_texture=false for a geometry-only mesh (cheaper), and pick a
model/resolution tier to trade off quality and cost.

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).
